projects.name: Move to the Bradford office
projects.goal: All 40 staff working from Bradford by the end of next quarter
projects.summary: The Leeds lease ends next year. Survey and design are done; the network is being built now, then move day.
projects.business_case:
The Leeds lease ends next year and renewing it costs more than the move.

Benefits: one site instead of two, room to grow, and a modern network with no legacy kit.
Costs: cabling and switches (quoted), two days of disruption on move day.
Main risks: kit delivery and landlord access - both in the RAID log.

projects.name: Windows 11 laptop refresh
projects.goal: Every laptop on Windows 11 before Windows 10 support ends
projects.summary: Two-week sprints, one department at a time. The standard image and the IT pilot are done.

projects.name: Firewall replacement
projects.goal: Both sites behind supported firewalls before the current pair goes end of life
projects.summary: The current firewalls go end of support in eight months. Proposed from the change advisory board.
projects.business_case:
The firewall pair at both sites goes end of support in eight months - no more security updates.

Options: replace like for like (£38k), move to a cloud firewall service (£22k a year), or do nothing (not acceptable).
Recommendation: like-for-like replacement, which the network team already knows.
projects.estimated_benefit: Removes an unsupported security device from both sites and cuts the support contract by £4,000 a year.

projects.name: Mail migration to the cloud

projects.summary: Batches of 50 mailboxes a week. Batch 2 hit throttling and the plan moved by two weeks.

projects.summary: Replaced tape with disk-to-cloud backup. Closed on time and under budget.

project_reports.title: Highlight report - month 1
project_reports.body:
## Where the project stands
On track overall. Survey and design closed with a **go**; the network build has started.

## Done this month
- Desk plan signed off by every manager
- Cabling and switches ordered

## Next
- Cabling on every floor
- Switches racked

## Risks and issues

## Budget
£23,600 spent of £57,600; the cabling invoice is still to come.

project_reports.title: Exception report - time tolerance
project_reports.body:
## The situation
Batch 2 is running at a third of the expected speed because the cloud service is throttling it. The **time tolerance (5 days)** will be exceeded.

## The cause
The largest mailboxes are in Sales; throttling limits are per tenant.

## If nothing changes
Cut-over slips about three weeks.

## Options
- Wait it out (3 weeks late)
- Pre-stage large mailboxes and add consultant days (2 weeks late, £4,800)
- Split Sales across two batches (2.5 weeks late)

## Recommendation
Option 2 - raised as CR-1.

project_reports.title: Closure report
project_reports.body:
## What was delivered
Every server backed up nightly to disk and the cloud; the tape library is gone.

## Against the plan
- Finished **2 days early**
- £22,750 spent of £23,800 - **£1,050 under**

## Benefits
- **Faster restores**: 18 hours to 1.2 - achieved
- **Backups that work**: 91% to 99.4% - achieved
- **Lower cost**: on the way - £10,200 against a target of £9,000; reviewed in six months (owner: Administrator)

## Lessons
- Test a restore before retiring anything
- Seed the first cloud copy from a disk

## Handover
The restore runbook is in Knowledge; monthly restore tests are a recurring task for the infrastructure team.
